name: Validate the username and password input boxes

steps.name: Given I am on the Zen Portal login page
Navigate to the Zen Portal login page
When I enter "sample.user@example.com" in the email field
And I enter "SamplePass123" in the password field
Enter password in the password field
Then the email field should contain "sample.user@example.com"
Verify the email field retains the entered value
And the password field should contain "SamplePass123"
Verify the password field retains the entered value
And the password field should be of type "password"
Verify the password field has type "password"

fullName: Zen Portal Login and Logout: Validate the username and password input boxes
